```{r population}
library(tidycensus)

library(tidyverse)

## Direct CSV from Census - 2010 to 2019
pop_annual <- read_csv("https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/datasets/2010-2019/state/totals/nst-est2019-alldata.csv") |>
  filter(STATE != 0) |>
  select(STATE, POPESTIMATE2010:POPESTIMATE2018) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("POP"),
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "population"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(str_extract(year, "\\d{4}")),
    state_fips = str_pad(STATE, 2, pad = "0")
  ) |>
  select(state_fips, year, population)
```


```{r merge population}
## Merge into main data and compute call rate
df_state <- df_state |>
  mutate(
    date  = as.Date(date_string_est),
    year  = year(date)
  ) |>
  left_join(pop_annual,
            by = c("state_fips", "year")) |>
  mutate(
    call_rate = num_calls / (population / 100000)
  )
# 2007-2018 population

pop_list <- map(2007:2018, function(yr) {
  get_estimates(
    geography = "state",
    product = "population",
    year = yr
  ) %>%
    filter(variable == "POP") %>%
    select(GEOID, NAME, value) %>%
    mutate(year = yr)
})

pop_annual <- bind_rows(pop_list) %>%
  rename(state_fips = GEOID,
         population = value)
```

```{r check agregatred data range}

df_state %>%
  group_by(year = lubridate::year(date_string_est)) %>%
  summarise(pct_na_answered = mean(is.na(pct_calls_answered)))

df_state |>
  mutate(year = as.integer(substr(date_string_est, 1, 4)))|>
  group_by(year) %>%
     summarise(na_rate = mean(is.na(pct_calls_answered)))

#疏松程度
# 检验各年数据密度
df_state %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(as.Date(date_string_est)),
    # 每年实际天数
    days_in_year = case_when(
      year == 2020 ~ 366,  # 闰年
      year == 2024 ~ 366,
      TRUE ~ 365
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(year, state_fips) %>%
  summarise(
    days_with_data = n(),
    days_expected = first(days_in_year),
    coverage = days_with_data / days_expected,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    states_above_80pct = sum(coverage > 0.8),
    states_above_50pct = sum(coverage > 0.5),
    median_coverage = round(median(coverage), 3),
    min_coverage = round(min(coverage), 3),
    n_states = n_distinct(state_fips),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  print(n = 25)

# 看有没有单位数FIPS，比如Alabama应该是"01"还是"1"
df_state %>% 
  distinct(state_fips) %>% 
  arrange(state_fips) %>% 
  head(10)
```

##EDA

```{r winds}
data("storm_winds")
head(storm_winds)
colnames(storm_winds)
nrow(storm_winds)

# number of winds
storm_winds %>% distinct(storm_id) %>% nrow()
```

```{r}
# hurr_tracks样本
hurr_tracks %>% slice(1:20) %>% as.data.frame() %>% print(row.names=FALSE)

# storm_winds样本
storm_winds %>% slice(1:20) %>% as.data.frame() %>% print(row.names=FALSE)

# storm_winds的wind值分布
summary(storm_winds$vmax_sust)

# fips的格式确认
storm_winds$fips[1:10]
```

```{r about wind}
# 1. 确认单位
range(storm_winds$vmax_sust, na.rm=T)

# 2. 确认已知强风暴的最大值
storm_winds %>%
  filter(grepl("2005|2017", usa_atcf_id)) %>%
  group_by(usa_atcf_id) %>%
  summarise(max_wind = max(vmax_sust)) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_wind)) %>%
  head(10)

# 3. 确认有多少场风暴和时间范围
storm_winds %>%
  summarise(
    n_storms = n_distinct(usa_atcf_id),
    n_counties = n_distinct(fips),
    year_range = paste(
      min(year(date_time_max_wind)),
      max(year(date_time_max_wind)),
      sep="-"
    )
  )
# 检查日期列
class(storm_winds$date_time_max_wind)
head(storm_winds$date_time_max_wind)

# 如果是字符型，需要转换
storm_winds <- storm_winds %>%
  mutate(
    date_time_max_wind = ymd_hms(date_time_max_wind),
    date_max_wind = as.Date(date_time_max_wind),
    year_storm = year(date_time_max_wind)
  )

# 再确认年份范围
range(storm_winds$year_storm, na.rm=T)
```
